name: markdown-editor
title: Markdown Editor
description: A markdown text editor with formatting toolbar, preview mode, and built-in English/French language toggle. Supports single-language and multi-language modes with per-language value objects. Compound or composed mode. Works with FormField.

docs.lead: A markdown text editor with formatting toolbar and live preview. Built-in English/French language toggle with per-language value storage — or single-language mode for simpler use cases. Uses `marked` for accurate markdown rendering.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Multi-language editor with built-in English/French toggle. Manages `{ en: "", fr: "" }` state internally.

examples.title: Single Language
examples.description: No language toggle. Value is a plain markdown string.
examples.code:
<MarkdownEditor.Composed
  toggleItems={false}
  placeholder="Write in a single language..."
/>

examples.title: Controlled Multi-Language
examples.description: Parent owns the per-language values object. The component handles language switching internally.

examples.title: Custom Toggle
examples.description: Override the default English/French toggle with custom language items.
examples.code:
<MarkdownEditor.Composed
  toggleItems={[
    { value: 'en', label: 'EN' },
    { value: 'fr', label: 'FR' },
    { value: 'es', label: 'ES' },
  ]}
  defaultToggleValue="en"
/>

examples.title: Compound
examples.description: Full compound mode with custom toolbar layout using the useMarkdownFormatting hook.

examples.title: With FormField
examples.description: Inside a FormField with label, required indicator, and hint.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disabled editor with muted toolbar and content.

examples.title: With Default Content
examples.description: Editor pre-filled with per-language markdown content. Toggle between languages to see different content. Click preview to see rendered markdown.
examples.code:
<MarkdownEditor.Composed
  defaultValue={{
    en: '# Hello\n\nThis is **bold** text.',
    fr: '# Bonjour\n\nCeci est du texte en **gras**.',
  }}
/>

api.name: MarkdownEditor.Root
api.description: The root container. Provides context for hasError, disabled, and previewing state.

props.name: hasError
props.description: Error state applied to the content area.

props.name: previewing
props.description: Whether the editor is in preview mode.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.ToolbarButton
api.description: An individual toolbar button with hover and active states.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip label shown on hover (xsmall size).

api.name: MarkdownEditor.ToolbarGroup
api.description: Groups toolbar buttons with consistent spacing.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.Toggle
api.description: Built-in SwitchToggle.Group for the toolbar. Used in compound mode.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.Content
api.description: The editor content area. Renders a textarea in edit mode and rendered HTML in preview mode.

props.name: height
props.description: Min-height of the editor content area.

props.name: value
props.description: The markdown content string for the current language.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.Composed
api.description: Props-driven composed mode with two variants: multi-language (default, with English/French toggle) and single-language (toggleItems={false}). In multi-language mode, value/onChange use a `LocalizedValue` object (`{ en: "", fr: "" }`). In single-language mode, value/onChange use a plain string.

props.name: toggleItems
props.description: Pass false to hide the toggle (single-language mode). Pass an array to override the default English/French items. Omit for default English/French toggle.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Object when toggle is shown, string when toggleItems={false}.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled value. Object when toggle is shown, string when toggleItems={false}.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback on change. Receives the full values object in multi-language mode, or a plain string in single-language mode.

props.name: onToggleChange
props.description: Callback when the active language changes (multi-language mode only).

props.name: height
props.description: Min-height of the editor content area.

api.name: useMarkdownFormatting
api.description: Hook that returns a function to apply markdown formatting actions to a textarea. Use with compound mode for custom toolbar buttons.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback when the value changes from formatting.

api.name: renderMarkdown
api.description: Converts a markdown string to HTML using marked with GFM support. Used internally for preview mode but exported for custom use.

migration.guide: v2.0.0 changes: (1) Replaced TipTap with plain textarea + marked for preview. Remove @tiptap/* dependencies. (2) Value type changed — multi-language mode now uses `{ en: '', fr: '' }` object instead of a single HTML string. Single-language mode uses `toggleItems={false}` with plain string value. (3) English/French toggle is shown by default — pass `toggleItems={false}` to hide it. (4) `onChange` returns `LocalizedValue` object in multi-language mode. (5) Requires `marked` npm dependency. (6) Requires `styles/markdown-editor.css` — auto-imported by CLI.
